description: Study Session Recommendations - Smart recommendation engine that analyzes all attempt data to automatically recommend what to study next (module, difficulty, question count, estimated time) with a 'Smart Next Session' button that auto-configures the optimal practice session.
steps: Step 1 - Recommendation Engine: Create src/features/question-bank/utils/session-recommender.ts. Functions: (a) computeStudyRecommendation(attempts: PracticeAttempt[], questions: Question[], repetitionQueue, targets?) -> StudyRecommendation. Algorithm: score each module by (gap-to-target * curriculum-weight * recency-decay). Factor in: weakest topics (lowest accuracy), spaced rep due count, time since last practice per module, difficulty readiness. Return: { recommendedModule, recommendedDifficulty, recommendedQuestionCount (10-30 based on available time), estimatedMinutes, reasoning: string explaining why }. (b) getQuickRecommendations(attempts, questions) -> array of 3 session options: 'Weakness Blitz' (focus hardest module, 10 Qs), 'Balanced Review' (mixed weak modules, 20 Qs), 'Challenge Mode' (ready-to-advance difficulty, 15 Qs).

Step 2 - Smart Session Component: Create src/features/question-bank/components/smart-session-card.tsx. A prominent card showing: (a) The primary recommendation with module name, difficulty badge, question count, estimated time, (b) A reasoning snippet explaining why ('You haven't practiced Corporate Issuers in 5 days and scored 62% last time'), (c) 'Start Smart Session' button that pre-configures session parameters and navigates to /questions/session/new (or /practice with params), (d) Three alternative quick-pick options as smaller cards below.

Step 3 - Session Auto-Configuration: When user clicks 'Start Smart Session', store the session config in sessionStorage (following existing session-configurator.tsx pattern) with the recommended module/difficulty/count, then navigate. Ensure the existing session-configurator or active-test-session can read these pre-configured params.

Step 4 - Integration: Add SmartSessionCard to the main questions page (src/app/(protected)/questions/page.tsx) as the top hero section. Also add it to the dashboard (src/app/(protected)/dashboard/page.tsx) as a prominent action card. Wire the recommendation engine to pull data from attempt-storage and practice-storage.

Step 5 - Unit tests: Create src/features/question-bank/__tests__/session-recommender.test.ts testing: (a) recommendation prioritizes weakest module, (b) recency decay works (longer since practice = higher priority), (c) difficulty readiness is respected, (d) quick recommendations generate 3 distinct options, (e) question count scales with available questions.
acceptance_criteria: Running bun run tsc --noEmit passes with no new errors
Running bun run vitest --run passes all new tests
Recommendation engine produces a valid StudyRecommendation with module, difficulty, count, time, reasoning
Smart Session card renders with recommendation details and Start button
Three alternative session options are generated with distinct configurations
Start Smart Session navigates with pre-configured parameters
Recommendations factor in curriculum weights, recency, and accuracy
findings: Algorithm uses practiceBonus (15 points) to prioritize modules with actual attempt data over unpracticed ones. Default accuracy for unpracticed modules set to 50% (not 0%) to prevent them from always dominating. Scoring formula: (accuracyGap * 0.5) + (recencyFactor * 25) + (weightFactor * 15) + practiceBonus. Quick recommendations filter to practiced modules only. Pre-existing env.test.ts failure (zod v4 issue) remains, all 10 new tests pass.
